name: WD-40
outlook:
What WD-40 says to expect

  • Fiscal year 2027: net salesNet sales growth is projected to be between 4% and 7% compared with fiscal year 2026, with net sales expected to be between $715 million and $735 million on a constant currency basis.
  • Fiscal year 2027: gross marginGross margin for the full year is expected to be between 54.0% and 55.5%.
  • Fiscal year 2027: operating incomeOperating income is projected to be between $114 million and $120 million, representing growth of 5% to 10% compared with fiscal year 2026.
  • Fiscal year 2027: diluted earnings per shareDiluted earnings per share is expected to be between $6.40 and $6.70, representing growth of 5% to 10% compared with fiscal year 2026, based on an estimated 13.4 million weighted average shares outstanding.
  • Fiscal year 2027: income tax provisionThe provision for income tax is expected to be between 22.5% and 23.5%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
